## 2. Ndepụta ọkpụkpọ M3U / M3U8

1. **Ntọala → Gbanwee onye na-eweta ọrụ → Ndepụta ọkpụkpọ M3U / M3U8**
2. **Họrọ ndepụta ọkpụkpọ → 1 → Dezie → URL ndepụta ọkpụkpọ**
3. **Tinye URL ndepụta ọkpụkpọ → Tọọ → Bugo ndepụta ọkpụkpọ**

```sh
npm run build:server
cargo run --release -p ottplay-server -- --port 8080
```
